summary: Validated public welcome UI, missing-credential guidance, Spotify status/error validation, and production build. Real Spotify OAuth was not testable because required credentials are absent.

integration_issues.issue: With Spotify configured=false, the app renders only the auth-first screen. The fallback preview tracks are only used inside generate(), but generate() throws when no token exists, so mood buttons, free-text, surprise-me, preview, and confirmation cannot be reached without credentials. This conflicts with the setup modal text saying the mood experience is ready to preview.

action_items: Decide whether preview mode should be available without OAuth; if yes, render the mood experience when credentials are missing and allow fallback generation while keeping creation locked.
Configure Spotify Client ID, Client Secret, and Redirect URI before attempting live OAuth/search/create-playlist verification.
critical_code_review_comments: FastAPI async Spotify handlers use blocking requests calls, which can block the event loop during Spotify latency; use an async HTTP client or run blocking calls off-loop before production.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL loads. Setup modal opens/closes. /api/spotify/status returns configured=false; login returns 503; missing required params return 422. test_credentials.md contains no credentials. Live OAuth and authorized playlist flows remain untested.
rca of the issue: App-level conditional rendering exits at `if (!token)` before mood controls can render. Although generate() has fallbackTracks, its first statement in the try block throws when token is absent, making the fallback unreachable in the missing-credential state.
